Re-score Step 1 (ZimmSlideIndicator molecule) of the SFCC-236 build — round 2, after rework. This is a small, bounded rework (3 single-line/phrase fixes), not a new implementation — verify the fixes landed correctly and didn't break anything, rather than re-running a full fresh audit from scratch.

## Round 1 verdict was REWORK, with exactly 3 required fixes (report separately: Design fidelity was UNVERIFIED — no visual checkpoint had been done — and that's still true, not addressed by this round; it isn't blocking further steps but the run isn't "done" until it happens)

1. `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts` background token: `var(--zimm-color-text-default)` → `var(--zimm-color-bg-05)` on the active branch (zero-visual-diff, semantically correct swap).
2. `index.stories.tsx` title: `'Elements/ZimmSlideIndicator'` → `'Commerce/ZimmSlideIndicator'`.
3. Uncitable "plan §4a"/"plan §4" comment fragments removed from `index.tsx:26`, `index.test.tsx:91`, `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts` (rationale prose kept, just the unreachable pointer removed) — replaced with bare `(SFCC-236)` references.

## Implementer's round-2 report (verify, don't just trust)
Claims all 3 fixes applied exactly as specified, plus incidentally caught a 4th instance of the same "plan §4" fragment on a comment near fix 1 that had drifted to a different line number than originally cited (same treatment applied — kept rationale, dropped the pointer). Claims:
- `tsc --noEmit` clean
- own component tests 12/12
- `recipeParts.test.ts` 24/24
- `recipeGuards.test.ts` 6/6

- `audit:tokens` shows only the pre-existing unrelated `footer.css.ts:20` finding
- `git status --porcelain` shows only the same 2 entries as round 1 (the 4 new component files + the 2-line theme/components/index.ts diff) — no new files, no other paths touched, `recipeGuards.test.ts`/`recipeParts.test.ts` read-only

## Your job
1. Read the actual current content of `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts` (the background line), `index.stories.tsx` (the title line), and the three comment locations — confirm the fixes are literally present as described, not just claimed.
2. Re-run the verification commands yourself:
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator

```
3. Confirm no new defect was introduced by the fixes themselves (e.g. did dropping "plan §4a" leave a comment that no longer parses/makes sense grammatically? did the token swap actually compile and produce identical computed styling?).
4. Re-check scope: still exactly the same 5 files, nothing else touched.

Give PASS or REWORK (round 2 of 3 max). If PASS, note explicitly that Design Fidelity remains UNVERIFIED pending the visual checkpoint (Storybook render of this component vs Figma node 40002536:7957) — that happens next, separately, before this step is committed; it is not this scoring round's job to perform it, just to flag it's still outstanding.

1	import type { SystemStyleObject } from '@chakra-ui/react';
2	
3	/**
4	 * Recipe for the touch-only PDP/card image position indicator — a 1px hairline strip, one
5	 * segment per image, the current position picked out by colour. Figma node 40002536:7957
6	 * ("Slide indicator") confirms only the strip's height (1px, flush to the image's bottom edge)
7	 * and that it is NOT floating dots; per-segment width/gap and the exact colour pairing are not
8	 * broken out in the export handed to this step, so both are treated as open design decisions
9	 * (documented below) rather than invented pixel-for-pixel guesses — same precedent as
10	 * zimmColourSwatchGroup's `pagination` part leaving an unconfirmed inter-button gap at the flex
11	 * default rather than inventing one.
12	 *
13	 * Two parts:
14	 *   - `root` — the full-width flex strip, exactly `--zimm-scale-025` (1px) tall.
15	 *   - `dot` — one equal-width segment per image (despite the part name, this renders as a
16	 *     rectangle in a hairline, not a circular dot — the name matches this component's
17	 *     already-agreed contract, not a literal shape description).
18	 */
19	export const ZimmSlideIndicator = {
20	  parts: ['root', 'dot'],
21	
22	  baseStyle: ({ isActive }: { isActive?: boolean }): Record<string, SystemStyleObject> => ({
23	    root: {
24	      display: 'flex',
25	      // Fluid, not a fixed Figma px width — matches the product card's own "fluid, not 288px"
26	      // rule: this strip always spans whatever width its image parent gives it, rather than
27	      // the specific 159.11px/99.44px bounding boxes the two sampled Figma variants happened
28	      // to measure at their own artboard widths.
29	      width: '100%',
30	      height: 'var(--zimm-scale-025)', // 1px — the one dimension Figma confirms directly.
31	      // No confirmed inter-segment gap value in the export handed to this step — left at 0
32	      // (segments flush-adjacent) rather than invented, so the strip reads as one continuous
33	      // hairline with the active segment picked out by colour alone. Revisit if a designer
34	      // confirms a real gap value.
35	      gap: 0,
36	    },
37	
38	    dot: {
39	      // Equal-width segments filling the strip — no confirmed per-segment width ratio exists
40	      // to justify an unequal split (see root's own comment above).
41	      flex: '1 0 0',
42	      height: '100%',
43	      // Both colours derive from the same grey/900 primitive (see foundation/colour.ts's
44	      // `opacity` family), so "active" and "inactive" read as solid vs. dimmed versions of one
45	      // hairline colour rather than two unrelated tones — a reasonable placeholder pairing
46	      // pending UI-designer confirmation of the exact treatment (only the strip's geometry, not
47	      // its colour, is confirmed by the Figma export handed to this step).
48	      background: isActive ? 'var(--zimm-color-bg-05)' : 'var(--zimm-color-opacity-40)',
49	    },
50	  }),
51	};

## Verdict: Round 2 re-score — ZimmSlideIndicator molecule (SFCC-236)

| Axis | Finding |
|---|---|
| **Design fidelity** | **UNVERIFIED** — unchanged from round 1, and correctly not attempted this round (task scope explicitly excludes it). No Storybook render vs. Figma node `40002536:7957` has happened yet. |
| **Restraint** | PASS — `git status --porcelain` / `git diff --stat` show exactly the same footprint as round 1: 4 new files under `zimmSlideIndicator/` + a 2-line additive diff in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`. Repo-wide grep for `ZimmSlideIndicator`/`zimmSlideIndicator` finds only these 5 files — no premature wiring into a parent/consumer, no scope creep from the incidental 4th fix. |
| **Pass criteria** | PASS — all 3 round-1 fixes confirmed present verbatim, plus the self-caught 4th instance of the same defect class, fully resolved. |
| **Correctness** | PASS — `tsc --noEmit` exit 0, `eslint` exit 0, component suite 12/12, `recipeParts.test.ts` 24/24, `recipeGuards.test.ts` 6/6, `audit:tokens` shows only the pre-existing unrelated `footer.css.ts:20` finding. All independently re-run, not taken on trust. |
| **Conformance** | PASS — token swap uses a real, registered var; role-correct; traced to source and confirmed value-identical to the old one. |
| **Completeness** | PASS — story (now correctly categorised) and test both present and passing; nothing about completeness regressed. |

**Overall: PASS** (round 2) — with Design Fidelity explicitly carried forward as **UNVERIFIED**, not resolved by this round, not this round's job, but not to be lost sight of before this step is considered committed.

### Fix-by-fix verification (CONFIRMED, not asserted)

1. **Background token** — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts:48` now reads `background: isActive ? 'var(--zimm-color-bg-05)' : 'var(--zimm-color-opacity-40)'`. CONFIRMED present. I also verified the "zero-visual-diff" claim wasn't just asserted: `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts:55` (`background['05']: grey[900]`) and `:61` (`text.default: grey[900]`) both alias the identical primitive — the swap is genuinely computed-value-identical, not just "close enough." `--zimm-color-bg-05` is registered at `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts:57`, so it isn't a plausible-looking but dead custom property.
2. **Story title** — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/molecules/zimmSlideIndicator/index.stories.tsx:5` reads `title: 'Commerce/ZimmSlideIndicator'`. CONFIRMED, and it's the actual `meta.title` field Storybook's sidebar consumes, not just a comment.
3. **"plan §" fragments** — `index.tsx:26` and `index.test.tsx:91` now read `(SFCC-236)`/`SFCC-236` in place of the old pointer, and both surrounding paragraphs are grammatically complete, coherent sentences (read in full, not just the cited lines). `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts` has no residual "plan §" text anywhere. A repo-wide `grep -rn "plan §" overrides/` returns zero hits, and a separate bare `grep -rn "§"` across the touched files also returns zero hits — falsifies both "missed a sibling occurrence" and "reworded into a different but still-uncitable form."
4. **Incidental 4th instance** — confirmed resolved as part of the same zero-hit grep above; no independent evidence of exactly which line it was on (untracked files, no round-1 commit to diff against), but the end-state is clean, which is what matters.

One asymmetry worth surfacing, not a defect: `index.tsx` and `index.test.tsx` got literal `(SFCC-236)`/`SFCC-236` replacement text; `zimmSlideIndicator.css.ts`'s cleaned-up comments carry no ticket reference at all, just self-contained rationale (backed by the real, checkable Figma node ID already in the header). The round-1 complaint was "uncitable," not "must contain this exact string" — the defect is resolved either way — but flagging it for visibility.

### What I tried to falsify

- Searched the whole `overrides/` tree (not just the 3 cited files) for `"plan §"` and, separately, a bare `"§"` in the touched files — to rule out a fix that satisfied the letter of the 3 citations while leaving a sibling occurrence, or reworded the citation into a different-but-still-uncitable form. Zero hits either way.
- Traced the token swap to `foundation/colour.ts` instead of trusting "these are both zimm vars so it's probably fine" — confirmed both old and new tokens alias the same `grey[900]` primitive, i.e. genuinely zero visual diff.
- Re-ran every verification command myself with explicit exit-code checks (`tsc`/`eslint` both exit 0) rather than trusting reported pass/fail counts.
- Grepped the whole repo for any new consumer of `ZimmSlideIndicator` to catch undisclosed integration beyond this step's scope. None found.
- Read full surrounding paragraphs (not just the cited lines) after the pointer removal, checking for a now-incoherent or dangling sentence. All read as complete, sensible prose.

### What I could not verify

- **Design fidelity** — still requires an actual Storybook render of this component compared against Figma node `40002536:7957`. Not attempted here per task scope; do not read this PASS as covering it.
- Did not run the full `npm run test` suite — only the specifically-scoped files requested. Residual risk is low (`recipeParts.test.ts` and `recipeGuards.test.ts` both walk the *entire* registered recipe map, not just this component, and both pass), but it isn't a full-suite confirmation.
- Did not re-check i18n message extraction for `slide_indicator.position.label` — unchanged since round 1, not one of the 3 cited fixes, out of this round's bounded scope.

### Biggest residual risk in shipping this step

Design fidelity remains the open item: nothing in this round (or round 1) has confirmed the rendered strip actually matches Figma node `40002536:7957` — height, colour pairing, and the flush-adjacent-segments treatment are all currently "best-guess pending designer sign-off" per the component's own comments. That checkpoint needs to happen before this step is treated as committed, separately from this scoring pass.
